title: System - technical monitoring
description: Development and operations dashboard: host, containers, processes, API, OPC UA collection, database. Requires the monitoring profile (./mesctl monitoring on).

panels.title: Fullest disk
panels.description: Fullest host file system.

panels.title: Running containers
panels.description: Docker containers running on the host.

panels.title: Points/s written
panels.description: Rows written per second to the historian (after deadband).

panels.title: Failing targets
panels.description: Exporters or services Prometheus cannot scrape (details at the bottom of the page).

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Share of total host CPU time, by mode (user, system, iowait...).

panels.title: Disks: IO/s (read ↑ / write ↓)
panels.description: Input/output operations per second, per disk.

panels.title: Disks: utilisation and wait
panels.description: Utilisation: % of time the disk is serving IO (100 % = saturated). Wait: mean write time in ms (right axis).

panels.title: CPU per container
panels.description: 100 % = one fully busy core.

panels.title: Memory per container
panels.description: Memory used excluding reclaimable cache (same value as docker stats).

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: All host containers. A short "Up for" or restarts indicate an unstable service.

panels.title: Processes (grouped by name)
panels.description: All processes of the Docker host, grouped by command name (postgres, python, nginx, grafana...).

panels.title: API: HTTP requests and background tasks
Error responses
panels.description: 4xx: request rejected (permissions, input); 5xx: server error.

targets.expr: (sum by (method, route) (rate(mes_api_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (method, route) (rate(mes_api_requests_total[5m]))) / sum by (method, route) (rate(mes_api_requests_total[5m]))

panels.title: In-flight requests and connection pool
panels.description: If busy connections reach "pool max", requests wait for a free connection.

panels.title: Background tasks: mean cycle time
panels.description: evenements: stop/alarm detection; shifts: shifts and KPIs; derives: motors; purge.

panels.title: Queue
panels.description: Rows received but not yet written to the database.

panels.title: Disk buffer
panels.description: Batches set aside while the database was unavailable; replayed automatically.

panels.title: Deadband filtering
panels.description: Share of received values dropped as unchanged (deadband).

panels.title: Collection rate
panels.description: Values per second.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: All connections to the mes database (active and idle).

panels.title: Cache hit
panels.description: Share of reads served from memory (shared_buffers). Aim for > 99 %.

panels.title: SQL time per second (5 most expensive queries)
panels.description: Cumulative execution seconds per second. The identifier refers to the ID column of the table below.

panels.title: Database IO
panels.description: Temporary files: sorts or joins that do not fit in memory (work_mem).

panels.title: Most expensive SQL queries (since database start)
panels.description: pg_stat_statements: cumulative time per normalised query. To reset: SELECT pg_stat_statements_reset();

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.queryid::text AS "ID", left(regexp_replace(s.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 160) AS "Query",
       s.calls AS "Calls",
       round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS "Mean (ms)",
       round(s.max_exec_time::numeric, 1) AS "Max (ms)",
       round((s.total_exec_time / 1000)::numeric, 1) AS "Total (s)",
       round((100 * s.total_exec_time / sum(s.total_exec_time) OVER ())::numeric, 1) AS "Share (%)",
       s.rows AS "Rows",
       round((100.0 * s.shared_blks_hit / nullif(s.shared_blks_hit + s.shared_blks_read, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Cache (%)"
FROM public.pg_stat_statements s JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid = s.dbid
WHERE d.datname = 'mes' AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_statements%'
ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Running queries
panels.description: Running SQL queries (excluding Grafana). Empty when the database is idle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pid AS "PID", usename AS "User", coalesce(application_name, '') AS "Application",
       client_addr::text AS "Client", state AS "State",
       coalesce(wait_event_type || ':' || wait_event, '') AS "Wait",
       round(extract(epoch FROM now() - query_start)::numeric, 1) AS "Duration (s)",
       left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 200) AS "Query"
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = 'mes' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND state <> 'idle' AND usename <> 'mes_reader'
ORDER BY query_start NULLS LAST

SELECT hypertable_schema || '.' || hypertable_name AS "Table",
       hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', hypertable_schema, hypertable_name)::regclass) AS "Size",
       num_chunks AS "Chunks", compression_enabled AS "Compression"
FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables
UNION ALL
SELECT schemaname || '.' || relname, pg_total_relation_size(relid), NULL, NULL
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE schemaname IN ('mes', 'catalog') AND pg_total_relation_size(relid) > 1048576
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15
